feed.title: Insightful Essays
feed.subtitle: A short, opinionated list of essays that are actually insightful.

entry.title: Anton Reicha: The String Quartets
entry.content:
Anton Reicha was an exact contemporary of Beethoven and his own highly individual and ambitious conception of what instrumental music could be after Haydn, but that music was largely forgotten, and most accounts of Reicha fail to depict what's interesting about it. Drummond turned me on to Reicha almost a decade ago, and how I am obsessed.

Anton Reicha: The String Quartets by Ron Drummond, classical.net · archived copy

entry.title: Kenny Felder's Essays
entry.content:
Clever essays on philosophy that combine extreme clarity and insight ("oh yeah, that's right, that's exactly how I'd put it if I could!") with a sort of outsider perspective.
